system.name: TAT (Trajectory Aggregation Tree)
system.one_liner: A training-free tree that aggregates historical and current trajectories sampled by a diffusion planner, weights and prunes nodes to resist infeasible trajectories.

content.variant_note: two stacked bands, (a) diffusion sampling and (b) tree aggregation, each repeated over three environment steps and ending in an ellipsis; the tree is redrawn at every step
content.argues: TAT sits downstream of an unchanged diffusion planner: trajectories sampled at each step are integrated into a weighted tree that is pruned as the environment moves on.
content.subject: The per-step diffusion sampling pipeline and the aggregation tree that integrates, weights and prunes the sampled trajectories, unrolled over three steps.

lessons.what_to_learn: Unroll a pipeline over time as aligned columns and stack two bands, the unchanged base pipeline above and the proposed downstream structure below, linked by a bold coloured arrow; redraw the evolving structure each step, shade nodes by weight and leave pruned parts as faded grey ghosts.
lessons.suits: Methods that add a training-free or downstream structure (tree, memory, cache, graph) on top of a base model and update it step by step along an episode or time.

evidence: The darker the red color, the higher the weight the node has.
The tree grows dynamically and keeps in sync with the environment by pruning branches (the light transparent gray part).

summary: TAT (Trajectory Aggregation Tree) is a training-free add-on for diffusion planners that merges trajectories sampled over successive environment steps into a tree, weights the nodes and prunes unreliable ones, so that stochastic infeasible trajectories are resisted. Figure 1 has two stacked panels over three aligned time columns. Panel (a) shows the unchanged diffusion pipeline: a walker figure gives the State, a cloud of red dots gives the Noise, and a grey Diffusion trapezoid samples chains of red trajectory nodes. Panel (b) shows a gold Integrate arrow merging the chains into a tree whose darker red nodes carry more weight, and grey Prune arrows leading to the next step, with pruned branches left as faded grey ghosts.
summary_zh: TAT是给扩散规划器加的免训练聚合树，把逐步采样的轨迹并入一棵树，按权重保留并剪枝。图1上下两栏、三个时间列：(a)状态与噪声经扩散模型采样出节点链；(b)金色Integrate合并成树，颜色越深权重越大，Prune后留下淡灰残影。
